CustomField.description: The deal this binder covers. LOOKUP with required=false and deleteConstraint=SetNull for the same reason as Loan__c.Transaction__c: a required lookup forces Restrict and would make every Transaction carrying a binder permanently undeletable, removing the only cheap rollback path a migration has.
